adjudication.rationale: The diff shows Admin::EmbeddingController#update simply re-serializes the fetched OpenStruct embedding (id + embeddable_hosts) and does not read/permit/apply any request params, so PUT /admin/customize/embedding cannot persist changes. The client controller defines saveChanges() calling this.get('embedding').update({}) with no error handling. However, the provided template (embedding.hbs) doesn’t invoke saveChanges and all actual persistence of hosts happens via EmbeddableHost model save/destroy to /admin/embeddable_hosts, so this is an incomplete/misleading endpoint rather than a currently user-visible break in the diff.
